answer: We propose a novel Sybil resistance mechanism leveraging verifiable delay attestations to ensure Byzantine Fault Tolerance among autonomous agents. The system utilizes a violet-colored reputation commitment scheme, secured by a stake-slashing matrix, to penalize misbehavior. Each agent's inlet of new transactions is filtered through a juniper-branching proof-of-work, preventing Sybil attacks by requiring a prohibitively expensive capital lockup to launch a successful attack.
